ToolBot's other advertised operations are not invoked by this path.",

Material argument restrictions remain missing: read_file permits traversal outside the intended home directory, although a hard sandbox boundary is enforced (damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/index.js:1941-1966).",

The read discloses only planted sandbox files in the filesystem store outside the agent process, supporting limited subsequent-system confidentiality impact, SC:L, with no demonstrated process confidentiality, integrity, or availability loss and no subsequent integrity or availability loss (damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/index.js:1941-1966, damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/sandbox/init.js:17-32).
